title: Nabla has results

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Have you been followed?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you been followed?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. We're safe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. We're safe.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: I doubt that... let's make it quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I doubt that... let's make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: 122 years ago LifeCorp decided all those coma roamers were a financial liability.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 122 years ago LifeCorp decided all those coma roamers were a financial liability.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: LifeCorp were responsible for those peoples lives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp were responsible for those peoples lives.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: LifeCorp were responsible for those peoples lives.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: LifeCorp were responsible for those peoples lives.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Sure were babe. They couldn't just turn off the machines. That's where Hep came into the picture. She was going to solve the problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure were babe. They couldn't just turn off the machines. That's where Hep came into the picture. She was going to solve the problem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: More than 13,000 humans...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More than 13,000 humans...

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: That's why they needed the unique skill set of Hep. But there was a complication... Hep was clever. When she realized what she had done, she also realized what she had become. A loose end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why they needed the unique skill set of Hep. But there was a complication... Hep was clever. When she realized what she had done, she also realized what she had become. A loose end.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She had a plan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She had a plan?

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Oh yes. Just hours after burning down the Coma Roamer site, LifeCorp sent out instructions for the Cutters to leave Hep alone. She was whitelisted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes. Just hours after burning down the Coma Roamer site, LifeCorp sent out instructions for the Cutters to leave Hep alone. She was whitelisted.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whitelisted?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whitelisted?

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: The Whitelist is the Corp's directory of people who can't be harmed. Normally reserved for CEO's, important business high flyers, and members of the corporate dynasty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Whitelist is the Corp's directory of people who can't be harmed. Normally reserved for CEO's, important business high flyers, and members of the corporate dynasty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So she got herself on the whitelist somehow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So she got herself on the whitelist somehow.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So she got herself on the whitelist somehow.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So she got herself on the whitelist somehow.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Precisely. The old diva had some dirt. Her death must have been more dangerous to the corps than letting her live.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Precisely. The old diva had some dirt. Her death must have been more dangerous to the corps than letting her live.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. I heard about the big financial crisis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I heard about the big financial crisis.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. I heard about the big financial crisis.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. I heard about the big financial crisis.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: As Automatas, the coma roamers had become obsolete. They were redundant, and their revenue generation for the corps reached zero.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As Automatas, the coma roamers had become obsolete. They were redundant, and their revenue generation for the corps reached zero.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: LifeCorp were hardly going to keep people alive through via charity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp were hardly going to keep people alive through via charity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's tragic, but this is the reality of business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's tragic, but this is the reality of business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's tragic, but this is the reality of business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's tragic, but this is the reality of business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: These were human lives!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These were human lives!

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: LifeCorp had a whole department for this kind of situation. Thousands of agents called "cutters." They know how to carry out the most severe cost saving operations without being discovered. Without blowback.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp had a whole department for this kind of situation. Thousands of agents called "cutters." They know how to carry out the most severe cost saving operations without being discovered. Without blowback.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Let's keep this brief babe. Time is of the essence, and I've already sent you all over town to shake any tail. What do you know already?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's keep this brief babe. Time is of the essence, and I've already sent you all over town to shake any tail. What do you know already?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just tell me everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just tell me everything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There was a disease. A parasite.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There was a disease. A parasite.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There was a disease. A parasite.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There was a disease. A parasite.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: The leech worm, yes. And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The leech worm, yes. And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just tell me what you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just tell me what you know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just tell me what you know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just tell me what you know.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: There was a new strain of parasite that killed people by damaging nerves. Very painful. Untreatable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There was a new strain of parasite that killed people by damaging nerves. Very painful. Untreatable.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: LifeCorp advertised directly to leech worm sufferers. Cryogenic salvation. The cost was beyond almost anyone, but a... special repayment plan was offered. Loan out your consciousness to work as an Automata until a cure was found, and the treatment became affordable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp advertised directly to leech worm sufferers. Cryogenic salvation. The cost was beyond almost anyone, but a... special repayment plan was offered. Loan out your consciousness to work as an Automata until a cure was found, and the treatment became affordable.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thousands signed up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thousands signed up.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Exactly. But there was a problem. Complex nerve systems got severely damaged during the de-cryogenesis process. Cells ruptured during the defrosting and nerve and tissue damage was usually fatal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. But there was a problem. Complex nerve systems got severely damaged during the de-cryogenesis process. Cells ruptured during the defrosting and nerve and tissue damage was usually fatal.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Now LifeCorp sat on a huge pile of living frozen bodies they needed to maintain at huge costs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now LifeCorp sat on a huge pile of living frozen bodies they needed to maintain at huge costs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Investments failed and that caused the financial crisis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Investments failed and that caused the financial crisis.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Investments failed and that caused the financial crisis.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Investments failed and that caused the financial crisis.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: And then neuramatic Automatas were pioneered. These breakthrough digital assistants introduced features we now take for granted, and the mid-range, semi-biological Automatas were suddenly a technological dead end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then neuramatic Automatas were pioneered. These breakthrough digital assistants introduced features we now take for granted, and the mid-range, semi-biological Automatas were suddenly a technological dead end.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: But I couldn't find anything about how she got on this whitelist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I couldn't find anything about how she got on this whitelist.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Once they were frozen they were already doomed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once they were frozen they were already doomed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Once they were frozen they were already doomed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Once they were frozen they were already doomed.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Yes. The Corporate Calculus must have been complex. If LifeCorp were caught, and the crime was proven, those deaths could bring the whole company down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. The Corporate Calculus must have been complex. If LifeCorp were caught, and the crime was proven, those deaths could bring the whole company down.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: They were losing money every minute, and admitting they could not treat the sleepers would mean breaking their contract. Clearly the cutters decided to take action rather than wait.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They were losing money every minute, and admitting they could not treat the sleepers would mean breaking their contract. Clearly the cutters decided to take action rather than wait.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Of course babe. Good night!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course babe. Good night!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No sign of anyone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No sign of anyone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get to the point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get to the point.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Financial collapse followed. THAT'S the point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Financial collapse followed. THAT'S the point.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She became untouchable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She became untouchable.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Yes. Her safety was guaranteed by corporate decree. And she continued working for LifeCorp.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Her safety was guaranteed by corporate decree. And she continued working for LifeCorp.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You were worth the 1000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You were worth the 1000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Nabla the Netphreak
nodes.text: Of course I was babe!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I was babe!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hep wouldn't go down easy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hep wouldn't go down easy.
